reproduction_target: Reproduce the meta-analysis results: from public MTBC short-read genomes (ENA accessions in Supplementary Data 1 + TB Portals), re-derive the QC-passing set of 5,882 genomes from 1,044 hosts, the 3,296 de novo fixed within-host mutations, the genome-wide mutation-enrichment hits (21 genes, 25 operons, 27 promoter regions; Figure 2A-C), and the per-drug resistance-acquisition proportions with 95% CIs.
granularity_note: No workflow file (Snakefile/CWL/Nextflow/WDL/Makefile) is referenced in the paper or on the GitHub landing page; the repo README describes 7 directories of scripts. Steps were therefore derived at one-step-per-named-tool-invocation granularity from the Methods prose (sections: Data sources; Genomic analyses applied to all MTBC isolate genomes; Genomic QC metrics and thresholds; Genomic analyses applied to isolates of the same host; Genome-wide mutation enrichment analysis; Determination of drug-resistance acquisition rates; Source of protein structures). |S| = 16, all layer C. Author Contributions states 'Laboratory methodology: not applicable' -> no W steps.

steps.label: Data sources: NCBI SRA queried April 2022 for BioProjects with multiple MTBC isolates per host; MTBC genomes + metadata additionally obtained from TB Portals; isolate IDs and metadata extracted from published studies, NCBI BioSample and TB Portals
Kraken v2.1.2 taxonomic classification of raw fastq for non-MTBC contamination, default parameters and default database built with `kraken2-build --standard`
TB-Profiler v4.2.0 lineage / sub-lineage assignment and drug-resistance mutation calling (https://github.com/jodyphelan/TBProfiler)
Snippy v4.6.0 read mapping to an ancestral version of the M. tuberculosis H37Rv reference genome and variant calling (SNPs, short indels) (https://github.com/tseemann/snippy)
Paired-end de novo assembly: SPAdes v3.15.3 plus the improve_assembly scaffolding/gap-filling pipeline (https://github.com/francesccoll/assembly_pipeline)
Single-end de novo assembly with SKESA 2.4.0
Assembly quality evaluation with QUAST v5.0.1 (contig count, total assembly bases, N50)

Genome QC metric aggregation and threshold filtering (Kraken MTBC read proportion <90%, mean depth <20, missing calls >10%, heterozygous-site ratio >0.002, contigs >1000, N50 <150,000 bp, assembly length <4.0 or >5.5 Mb); repo directory genome_qc

Clonality filtering of same-host isolates: exclude if different TB-Profiler lowest-level sub-lineage or same sub-lineage separated by >10 SNPs; pairwise SNP distances and per-lineage phylogenies (repo directory population_analyses)

MRCA reconstruction pipeline for same-host isolates: within-host phylogenies with RAxML v8.2.8 rooted on a contextual outgroup isolate, ancestral sequence reconstruction with PastML v1.9.20; four named python scripts identify_host_ancestral_isolate.step1.py - step4.py in https://github.com/francesccoll/mtbc-adaptive-mutations/
de novo variant calling against the reconstructed MRCA sequence with Snippy (repo directory snippy_mrca)

Repetitive / low-complexity / low-confidence region masking: Blastn v2.8.1+ of the reference against itself, dustmasker v1.0.0 with default settings, plus published masked-region and low-confidence-region sets (total 735,968 bp, 16.7% of H37Rv) excluded
Variant annotation of the final high-quality variant set with SnpEff v4.3 against the H37Rv reference genome

Reference annotation acquisition: H37Rv annotated genome release 4 (2021-03-23) from https://mycobrowser.epfl.ch/releases as CDS source; transcriptional units (operons) downloaded from https://mycobacterium.biocyc.org/ (no version/date stated for BioCyc)

Genome-wide mutation enrichment analysis in R (repo directory association): count HIGH/MODERATE-impact mutations per CDS, per operon, and per 100-bp upstream promoter region; single-tailed Poisson test with expected count = genome-wide mutations-per-bp x locus length; Benjamini-Hochberg correction over all functional units; significance level 0.05

Drug-resistance acquisition rate determination (repo directory dr_acquisition): treatment data from TB Portals / published studies (Supplementary Table 3), binary per-drug variables, fluoroquinolone and protionamide/ethionamide recoding, DR gene-to-drug categorisation (Supplementary Table 2), proportions with 95% confidence intervals for 14 drugs

Protein structure sourcing and modelling: crystal structures from PDB (8DV5 WhiB6-sigmaA4, 4KPG M. smegmatis MycP1 orthologue, 5UKV PhoR dimerization-phosphorylation domain); AlphaFold 3D models generated for EccE1, EspK, MycP1 and the PhoR homodimer; r.m.s.d. 0.299 A over 312 C-alpha atoms reported

headline.static_readiness: 0/17 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification). Unexecuted; declared environment statically valid but not verified as the env that produced the results. Under-claims by construction - Tier-1 cannot credit an undeclared-but-present dependency. n_exact_capture_unexecuted=0, n_fetch_required=0 (env_capture_class deliberately n/a at stage1-prose-only).
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: 12/17 (71%) readiness upper bound (n_R-star + n_RI)/|S| - 'documented sufficiently for a reproduction attempt', never 'reproducible'.
headline.coverage: 17/17 (100%) computational coverage (|S|/(|S|+|W|)); pure-computational meta-analysis, no wet-lab steps (Author Contributions: 'Laboratory methodology: not applicable').

gaps.where: S08 genome QC thresholding, S15 mutation-enrichment analysis (R code, repo directory association), S16 DR acquisition rates (repo directory dr_acquisition)
gaps.missing: No version stated for R, for any R package, or for the authors' own scripts; the GitHub repository has no release and no tag (GitHub API /releases and /tags both return empty), so there is no commit-level or release-level pin for the analysis code that produces Figure 2 and the DR-acquisition proportions.
gaps.how_to_close: Cut a tagged release / Zenodo-archived DOI of the repository at the version used for the manuscript, and state the R version plus sessionInfo() / renv.lock for the association and dr_acquisition analyses.

gaps.where: All external-tool steps S02-S07, S10-S13 (Kraken v2.1.2, TB-Profiler v4.2.0, Snippy v4.6.0, SPAdes v3.15.3, SKESA 2.4.0, QUAST v5.0.1, PastML v1.9.20, RAxML v8.2.8, Blastn v2.8.1+, dustmasker v1.0.0, SnpEff v4.3)
gaps.missing: Exact version numbers are given in prose for eleven tools, but there is no environment closure: no interpreter/runtime version, no channel/index or package source, no declared platform, no conda-lock/pixi.lock/renv.lock, and no container image or digest is mentioned in the paper or on the repository landing page. Per rubric Delta-2 this is exact_pins_partial, capping Version at 1.
gaps.how_to_close: Ship a conda-lock / pixi.lock (or a container image referenced by digest) covering the declared platform, alongside the existing prose pins.

gaps.where: S02 Kraken2 standard database; S03 TB-Profiler resistance-mutation database; S12 published masked/low-confidence region sets; S13 SnpEff H37Rv annotation database; S14 Mycobrowser and BioCyc downloads
gaps.missing: Reference-database provenance is partly out-of-band and only partly pinned. The Kraken2 database is described only as the default built with `kraken2-build --standard` (no build date, no NCBI snapshot); the TB-Profiler and SnpEff bundled databases are not separately versioned; the BioCyc operon set has no version or download date. Only the Mycobrowser H37Rv annotation is pinned (release 4, 2021-03-23).
gaps.how_to_close: Record the build/download date or checksum for the Kraken2 standard database, the TB-Profiler DB version, the SnpEff database build, and the BioCyc operon download date; ideally fetch each via a versioned URL/DOI inside a download rule in the repository (env_capture_class A).

gaps.where: S01 data sources; S16 drug-treatment data
gaps.missing: Per-sample identifiers are not enumerated in the article body. ENA run/BioSample accessions, host IDs and the isolate-to-patient mapping live only in Supplementary Data 1; drug-treatment data live in Supplementary Data 4 and Supplementary Table 3. The Data availability statement gives no BioProject-level accession list in the text, and the SRA query itself is described by inclusion criteria rather than by an executable query.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the accession/metadata table (and the DR-gene-to-drug categorisation table) as a machine-readable file in the repository or a data archive, and include the exact SRA query string plus the query date snapshot.

gaps.missing: The improve_assembly step is externalised to a second repository (https://github.com/francesccoll/assembly_pipeline) referenced by bare URL with no commit, tag or version.
gaps.how_to_close: Pin the sub-pipeline by commit SHA or tagged release from the main repository.

gaps.missing: No code, no AlphaFold version (AlphaFold2 vs AlphaFold3 not stated), no database version, no run settings, and no deposited predicted-model coordinates for EccE1, EspK, MycP1 and the PhoR homodimer. Only the three experimental PDB accessions (8DV5, 4KPG, 5UKV) are resolvable.
gaps.how_to_close: State the AlphaFold implementation and version (or ColabFold commit), the sequence database versions used, and deposit the predicted model coordinate files in the repository or ModelArchive.

gaps.missing: TB Portals (https://tbportals.niaid.nih.gov/) resolves 200 but is a live query portal, not a fixed snapshot; the April 2022 extraction cannot be re-obtained by URL alone. The Data availability statement asserts all sequences are on ENA under the Supplementary Data 1 accessions, which mitigates but does not remove this.
gaps.how_to_close: Record the TB Portals extraction date and the exact filter set, or deposit the derived metadata table used.

gaps.where: S10 within-host phylogeny and ancestral reconstruction (RAxML v8.2.8 + PastML v1.9.20)
gaps.missing: No random seed, substitution model, bootstrap setting or PastML reconstruction method (marginal/joint, ACCTRAN/MPPA) is stated for the phylogeny and ancestral-state reconstruction. Under the rubric this caps the step at RI (distributional-only risk) even if all other axes were complete.
gaps.how_to_close: State the RAxML model and seed and the PastML prediction method, or ship the invocation command lines in the identify_ancestral directory README.
